status_definitions.implemented: Source implements the stated operation; this is not an installed-platform or release qualification.
status_definitions.qualified-bounded: Historical native acceptance exists only for the stated cases and recorded source.
status_definitions.experimental: Implemented pieces or contracts exist, with the stated qualification gaps.
status_definitions.known-defect: A concrete method or correctness defect prevents the advertised guarantee.
status_definitions.unsupported: Current execution is explicitly unavailable; no alternative host core is supported.
status_definitions.planned: An approved implementation or research plan exists; capability is not delivered.

native49.scope: Recorded MPI 2/4-rank cases and Mac ARM64/Colab Linux x86-64 gRPC cases; historical bounded acceptance.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Rust scheduling, state and RNG
capabilities.scope: Event ordering, cancellation, generational state and versioned RNG streams are implemented in Rust.
capabilities.limitations: Native platform, replay/version and installed-package qualification are separate gates.

capabilities.name: DES and ABM modelling
capabilities.scope: Rust resource/trajectory and agent/spatial APIs exist.
capabilities.limitations: Full hybrid boundary semantics, analytical scenarios and empirical model validation remain scoped obligations S17.

capabilities.name: C ABI scheduling and statistics
capabilities.scope: Rust ABI v1 exports handle creation, scheduling, stepping, cancellation and statistics.
capabilities.limitations: Counts do not identify dispatched events. Validate ownership/overflow/error behavior per binding.

capabilities.name: Python NativeEngine
capabilities.scope: Thin ctypes adapter calls Rust ABI v1; no Python simulation core.
capabilities.limitations: Actual shared-library CI and installed package/platform acceptance remain required; legacy Scheduler is unavailable.

capabilities.name: TypeScript loader and Rust Wasm scheduler
capabilities.scope: Generated wasm-bindgen module owns simulation execution.
capabilities.limitations: Generated-artefact execution and safe API qualification are separate gates; current run_for maps native error to zero and JSON u64 statistics need precision handling. Inspector/debug metadata is unqualified.

capabilities.name: R, Julia and Go simulation adapters
capabilities.scope: DTOs and package metadata may remain available.
capabilities.limitations: Simulation constructors fail or are unavailable until real Rust dispatch is implemented and separately qualified.

capabilities.name: C# native ABI declarations
capabilities.scope: Raw native lifecycle/schedule/run/statistics APIs can call the Rust ABI.
capabilities.limitations: Managed DeterministicScheduler is retired; actual native CI and installed-package qualification are separate.

capabilities.name: Python Gymnasium environment
capabilities.scope: Constructor and registration reject until a qualified Rust environment exists.
capabilities.limitations: Installing Gymnasium does not enable execution; S10 retains actual native environment and checker work.

capabilities.name: Optimistic/distributed Rust runtime
capabilities.scope: Recorded MPI 2/4-rank and two-host gRPC tests cover specified rollback, crash/restart and fixed-LP entity transfer cases.
capabilities.limitations: Historical acceptance applies to recorded sources and cases; no cross-host MPI, whole-LP relocation, cluster or scaling certification.

capabilities.name: Measured PDES performance baseline
capabilities.scope: Eight raw Oct 2026 benchmark rows include five timing repeats, event counts and parity; this small workload is slower than sequential.
capabilities.limitations: This historical hardware/workload baseline is not a universal performance result or a result for the current change.

capabilities.name: HPC weak/strong scaling certification
capabilities.scope: Benchmark scaffolding and synthetic report generation exist.
capabilities.limitations: Formula-generated 92%/84% and 3.36x are not measurements and cannot certify scaling.

capabilities.name: GPU acceleration
capabilities.scope: Native operation-specific GPU kernels have bounded evidence recorded in existing tracks.
capabilities.limitations: Full arbitrary-model execution, exactness/tolerance contracts and speed/energy advantages require S11.

capabilities.name: Arrow/Polars data interchange
capabilities.scope: Rust native data export and separate Arrow C Data interfaces exist.
capabilities.limitations: kairo_ecs_telemetry_flush_ipc returns JSON statistics; Python DTO conversion is not proof of populated native zero-copy export.

capabilities.name: Classical fourth-order integration
capabilities.scope: The existing step_continuous_rk4 method uses an Euler-style update and normalization.
capabilities.limitations: Do not claim RK4 order or general ODE correctness until S01 independent convergence tests pass.

capabilities.name: General Lemke–Howson/Nash solving
capabilities.scope: The current named solver is a bounded 2x2 algebraic routine.
capabilities.limitations: Dominance/degeneracy cases do not establish general equilibrium correctness; S02 requires independent residual/oracle checks.

capabilities.name: Correlated-equilibrium optimisation
capabilities.scope: A maintained Clarabel-backed path exists.
capabilities.limitations: S03 must verify the implemented incentive constraints, feasibility and objective against independent games.

capabilities.name: General CFR/CFR+
capabilities.scope: Kuhn-specific execution is present.
capabilities.limitations: Generic extensive-form and Leduc support require S04; a method name or convergence field does not prove them.

capabilities.name: Standard Sobol and sensitivity analysis
capabilities.scope: Existing sequence and ensemble scaffolding are present.
capabilities.limitations: Known nonstandard vectors, 2^32 index overflow and fixed-multiplier confidence fields require S05; preserve explicitly versioned legacy replay. Those fields are not statistical confidence intervals.

capabilities.name: CRN, ensembles and uncertainty
capabilities.scope: Deterministic stream/ensemble components exist.
capabilities.limitations: S06–S08 require coverage, calibration, hazard and reference-posterior evidence. The current ABC-SMC-named routine lacks sequential resampling/perturbation; distance-weighted fixed particles do not establish ABC-SMC.

capabilities.name: Real ONNX inference and vector environments
capabilities.scope: Shape/backend contracts and stubs exist in Rust.
capabilities.limitations: Identity passthrough and synthetic rewards are not real model inference or environment dynamics; S09–S10 remain open.

capabilities.name: External FMI/FMU interoperability
capabilities.scope: Native FMU loading and repository-controlled fixtures exist.
capabilities.limitations: Independent Reference-FMUs and external-tool roundtrips are required by S13.

capabilities.name: NUMA, parallel I/O and model restart
capabilities.scope: Contracts and selected implementation pieces exist.
capabilities.limitations: Format-shaped bytes are not HDF5/ADIOS2 files; metadata/checkpoint export alone does not restore a model. S14 remains open.

capabilities.name: Reversible debugging and causal provenance
capabilities.scope: Selected native checkpoint/inspection components exist.
capabilities.limitations: Constructed Wasm inspector provenance and constant bookkeeping do not prove rollback, historical inspection or time travel. S15 remains open.

capabilities.name: WebSocket and streaming interoperability
capabilities.scope: Transport components and dependency decisions exist.
capabilities.limitations: S16 requires actual interoperable protocols, ordering and backpressure; custom framed TCP is not WebSocket.

capabilities.name: Independent CareOps consumer contract
capabilities.scope: Kairos provides versioned generic engine/data contracts; careops-sim owns domain models and validation.
capabilities.limitations: A standalone public-interface consumer fixture and downstream installed acceptance remain required; no consumer pin is promoted.

capabilities.name: Beta and stable release
capabilities.scope: v0.4.0-alpha.1 is the existing release; bounded beta/stable gates are defined.
capabilities.limitations: New tests, plans and historical Done labels do not constitute beta/stable acceptance or publication.

capabilities.name: Beyond-frontier research claims
capabilities.scope: Predeclared experiments cover deterministic execution planning, policy branching and executable evidence.
capabilities.limitations: No universal leadership or scientific novelty is asserted before independent baselines, held-out evaluation and reproduction.
